ideas.text: One main currency for the whole game; materials (books) from quest-style tasks.
Finish UI + all infrastructure + admin first; only art production remains afterwards.
A place in the admin panel to follow development and review the UI together.
If a test or step fails more than twice: raise reasoning, note it, move on.
Currency name in the style of 'Bell's Remains', fitting the story.
Rewarded ads: max 5 per 12 hours, mirrored in the game; rewards decided in the final math pass.
